2.The present writ petition is filed praying for a writ of mandamus, to direct the respondents to compute and pay to the petitioner for acquisition of her lands 1.19 acres in S.No.239/1E2 and in 1.70 acres in S.Nos.238/1B2 & 240/5 situated at Karanai Revenue Village, Cheyyar Taluk,
Tiruvannamalai District, acquired under the Tamil Nadu Acquisition of Land for Industrial Purpose Act, 1997, covered under Award Notice of the 4th Respondent in Na.Ka.No.A2/324/2021 dated 03.02.2025, the benefits under the provisions of sections 26 to 30 and also Chapter V & I, II Schedule of The Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013 and also to dispose of the common representation of the petitioner dated 20.06.2023, 01.07.2024 and 03.03.2025.
Bhavani vs The Secretary To The Government on 5 June, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/166475281/
2 3.After submitting for a brief while, learned Special Government Pleader would submit that the communication dated 03.02.2025 wherein it was stated that in respect of S.Nos.239/1E2, 238/1B2 & 240/5, the person claiming ownership shall obtain approval from the Revenue Divisional Officer and thereafter, may approach the Principal District https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis ( Uploaded on: 20/06/2025 03:41:37 pm ) Judge, Tiruvannamalai.

4.It is submitted by the learned counsel for the petitioner that they may be granted liberty to obtain approval from the Revenue Divisional Officer and thereafter, approach the Principal District Judge,
Tiruvannamalai, in support of its claim for computation and payment of compensation under the Tamil Nadu Acquisition of Land for Industrial Purposes Act, 1997 and under the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013.
